Final boot touches original sheet bottom border; playback restores existing idle instead.

packaging: Native-alpha artwork only. Complete connected figures separated by actual pixel components rather than rigid grid cuts; neighboring figure pixels excluded; whole figures translated to a common foot anchor. No artwork repainting, keying, warping or body-part deformation. Effect components assigned to their logical frame with transparent padding; neighboring components excluded without removing native glow. Visible alpha envelopes are recorded for viewport-safe effect placement. Frame-specific natural standing body scale recorded separately from crouch height.

userCorrections.result: Full-screen flash, haze and dim overlays removed; light stays local to the FX.
